name: Smart Drinks
summary: In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix seeks a new formula for his drink. His brew of powdered Sunscale raptor horns disappointed him, so he now wants ectoplasmic residue from the Wailing Caverns.

sections.title: A Recipe for Disaster
sections.body: Mebok Mizzyrix sells goods in Ratchet and hopes to make a fortune with a drink that sharpens the mind. His first formula used powdered Sunscale raptor horns, but the brew disappointed him. Now he has turned to the strange essence seeping from the Wailing Caverns, hoping it will make his drink succeed.

sections.title: The Wailing Essence
sections.body: Strange changes have come to the Barrens. New oases have appeared, and local wildlife has grown aggressive and warped. Mebok suspects a substance he calls Wailing Essence is behind them. He sends you into the cavern labyrinth to destroy its oozing ectoplasms and gather their glowing fluid in bottles for his formula.

faq.answer: Mebok Mizzyrix is a goblin merchant in Ratchet. He hopes to sell an intellect-boosting drink across Kalimdor and make a fortune.

faq.q: Why didn't the raptor horns work?
faq.answer: Mebok thought powdered horns from Sunscale raptors would make an intellect-boosting brew, but the drink disappointed him. Now he has turned to a more dangerous ingredient.
Wailing Essence is ectoplasmic fluid from strange slimes deep inside the Wailing Caverns. Mebok believes it causes the unusual changes to plants and animals spreading through the Barrens.

faq.q: Where do you find the ectoplasms carrying the essence?
faq.answer: You can gather the essence from evolving, devouring, and nightmare ectoplasms in the underground tunnels of the Wailing Caverns, west of Ratchet.

faq.q: Is the smart drink safe to consume?
faq.answer: The essence comes from nightmarish slimes linked to corrupting mutations across the Barrens, so bottling it as a tonic is reckless. Mebok cares more about selling the drink than keeping customers safe.

faq.q: What comes after completing Smart Drinks?
faq.answer: After you deliver Wailing Essence, Mebok considers his immediate beverage venture complete. He rewards you and promises a share of future profits if his tonic makes him a fortune.

angles.text: If you cook, raw ectoplasm tainted by nightmare is a poor choice for a drink. Mebok wants to steep it into a tonic despite the danger to food safety.
As a druid, you enter the Wailing Caverns to cleanse the nightmare twisting the emerald dreamscape. Mebok sees that ecological taint as cheap syrup for his business.
As a member of the Horde, you can find quick coin among the Barrens' crossroads merchants in Ratchet. Mebok's business asks you to deliver monster parts without many questions.
